Local changes for vrclib (marked "vrclib patch"):
- background colour for the window and the web view before the first paint
- WM_DPICHANGED handling, small icon, arrow cursor, centring on the work area
- no log.Fatal when WebView2 cannot start: the window is destroyed and New returns nil
- MoveHook: called when the window moves, for a second web view inside it
- CloseHook: asked on WM_CLOSE, false keeps the window open (downloads under way)
- edge.Chromium.Plain and pkg/edge/vrclib_plain.go: a web view that only shows a site (nothing put into its
  pages, no script run in them, no handler of the host's on it), with its address, title and history asked for
  from the host side
- failures while a view is created are seen as failures (an HRESULT was compared as a 64-bit number), and the
  message that ends the program is not swallowed when the window is closed while a view is being created
Upstream: https://github.com/jchv/go-webview2 @ 56598839c808a2340edee99204db479f410e9bf4
